instruction: Write an XDP/eBPF program that counts valid IPv4 TCP packets by TCP control flags in array map 'tcp_flag_counters' (type BPF_MAP_TYPE_PERCPU_ARRAY, key __u32 [0=SYN, 1=FIN, 2=RST, 3=Other], val __u64 count, max_entries 4). Define flag precedence: (1) If SYN flag is set (flags & 0x02) -> slot 0, (2) Else if FIN flag is set (flags & 0x01) -> slot 1, (3) Else if RST flag is set (flags & 0x04) -> slot 2, (4) Else (ACK only, PSH+ACK, URG, etc.) -> slot 3. If the packet is not valid IPv4 TCP, do not increment any slot. Return XDP_PASS for all packets.
requirements: Check Ethernet and IPv4 bounds, verify ip->protocol == IPPROTO_TCP
Parse variable IHL (ip->ihl * 4) and verify TCP header bounds
Inspect TCP flags at offset 13 of TCP header
Apply precedence: SYN (0x02) -> 0; FIN (0x01) -> 1; RST (0x04) -> 2; other -> 3
GPL license and SEC("xdp") entry point

tests.name: syn_slot0
tests.description: TCP SYN (0x02) increments slot 0 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: syn_ack_slot0
tests.description: TCP SYN+ACK (0x12) increments slot 0 (SYN precedence) and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: fin_slot1
tests.description: TCP FIN (0x01) increments slot 1 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: fin_ack_slot1
tests.description: TCP FIN+ACK (0x11) increments slot 1 (FIN precedence) and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: rst_slot2
tests.description: TCP RST (0x04) increments slot 2 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: rst_ack_slot2
tests.description: TCP RST+ACK (0x14) increments slot 2 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: ack_slot3
tests.description: TCP pure ACK (0x10) increments slot 3 and returns XDP_PASS

tests.name: psh_ack_slot3
tests.description: TCP PSH+ACK (0x18) increments slot 3 and returns XDP_PASS
